metadata.name: Delta Number Ticker – Rolling Number with Animated Change Chip and Previous Value
metadata.description: Delta Number Ticker for React and Tailwind CSS (shadcn/ui): digits roll on every change while a chip with the absolute and percent change lifts off the number and settles beside it, and the old value lingers below as a ghost. It is built to show how much and which way a figure moved. Columns roll with a 20 ms stagger, new columns grow in for extra digits, and goodDirection paints a falling latency as good. Controlled previousValue or own memory, Intl formatting, polite announcements, reduced motion, light and dark. Use it for KPIs, prices, balances, latency and stock. The included demo plays a fixed storefront scenario and makes no requests. Requires React only, with no animation library.
metadata.author: dhxwhy
